headphoneProfiles.name: Creative Inspire 5300
headphoneProfiles.source: Real product (Creative Inspire 5.1 5300, satellite+subwoofer PC speaker set, rated 47Hz-20kHz). No professional coupler/GRAS measurement of this specific unit is publicly available anywhere reachable (AutoEq, squig.link, Rtings all cover headphones/IEMs, not 2003-era budget PC speaker sets) — no curve is shipped rather than inventing one. Selecting this profile applies DeviceType.HomeSpeaker's documented, literature-cited class-average correction (see DeviceType.kt) at this unit's budget quality tier.

headphoneProfiles.name: TANGZU Wan'er S.G. 2 Red Lion
headphoneProfiles.source: Real product, measured by Crinacle/others on squig.link (e.g. boizoff.squig.link, arn.squig.link, csi-zone.squig.link all list it) — but every raw-data endpoint checked returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) and AutoEq has no published result (see closed request github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq/issues/735). No curve is shipped rather than inventing one. Selecting this profile applies DeviceType.Iem's documented class-average correction at this unit's mid quality tier. Replace with a real curve the moment squig.link data becomes fetchable, or paste the graph and it can be digitized by hand.
